slaughterhouse-shipments.title: Slaughterhouse shipments
slaughterhouse-shipments.summary: We arrange the sale and shipment of finished cattle with the main slaughterhouses in the country.
slaughterhouse-shipments.description: We negotiate the sale of finished cattle with the main slaughterhouses and arrange the shipment, looking for the best price and term for each category, weight and finish.
points: Daily quotes from the slaughterhouses
Negotiation of price, term and slaughter date
Shipping and paperwork arranged for you
Follow-up of the carcass report and settlement

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We look at the cattle and share the day's quotes.

steps.title: Deal
steps.text: We close price, term and date with the chosen slaughterhouse.

steps.title: Shipping
steps.text: We arrange freight and follow the slaughter until settlement.

private-deals.title: Private deals
private-deals.summary: Direct sales between producers, backed by the reliability of the firm.
private-deals.description: We connect buyers and sellers for direct cattle deals outside the auction ring. The firm guarantees the deal and handles inspection, weighing and payment.
points: Buyers and sellers across the country
Inspection and weighing agreed by both parties
Payment guaranteed by the firm
Advice on price and terms

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Tell us what you want to buy or sell.

steps.title: Search
steps.text: We present options that match your request.

steps.title: Closing
steps.text: We handle inspection, weighing and payment.

screen-auctions.title: Screen auctions
screen-auctions.summary: Cattle filmed on the farm and sold on a broadcast, with no transport or shrink.
screen-auctions.description: We film the cattle on the farm and sell them on a live broadcast. Buyers see every lot with full details, and sellers do not move or shrink animals until the deal is closed.
points: Filming and inspection of every lot on the farm
Online catalog with photos, video and lot details
Live broadcast with bids by phone or WhatsApp
Payment terms and guarantees arranged by the firm

steps.title: Inspection
steps.text: An agent visits the farm, inspects the cattle and builds the lots.

steps.title: Catalog
steps.text: We publish photos, video and details of every lot before the sale.

steps.title: Auction and shipping
steps.text: The lots sell live and we arrange freight to destination.

land.title: Land sales and leases
land.summary: Livestock and crop farms on the Uruguay River coast, with advice at every step.
land.description: We sell and lease livestock and crop farms on the Uruguay River coast. We know the soils, water and infrastructure of each area, so our advice is grounded.
points: Farms for sale and for lease
Survey of soils, water and infrastructure
Visits with an agent
Support through negotiation and deeds

steps.title: Survey
steps.text: We walk the farm and assess its productive potential.

steps.title: Marketing
steps.text: We present it to qualified buyers or tenants.

steps.title: Contract
steps.text: We support the negotiation until signing.

appraisals.title: Appraisals
appraisals.summary: Cattle and land appraisals for banks, estates and private owners.
appraisals.description: We appraise cattle and land for banks, estates, companies and private owners, with a well-founded report based on current market values.
points: Appraisal of herds and cattle lots
Appraisal of livestock and crop farms
Reports for banks and estates
Values based on recent transactions

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Tell us what needs to be appraised and why.

steps.title: Visit
steps.text: An appraiser walks the farm or inspects the cattle.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: We deliver the signed report with its rationale.

transport.title: Transport
transport.summary: Freight arranged with licensed carriers and tracking for every load.
transport.description: We arrange cattle freight with licensed carriers for auctions, fairs, shipments and private deals, tracking every load.
points: Licensed and insured carriers
Permits and paperwork up to date
Loads coordinated with farm and destination
Tracking until unloading

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Send us origin, destination, head count and date.

steps.title: Coordination
steps.text: We assign the truck and prepare the paperwork.

steps.title: Trip
steps.text: We follow the load until it reaches its destination.

fairs.title: Saleyard fairs
fairs.summary: Replacement cattle fairs at our Paysandú saleyard and across the region.
fairs.description: We run replacement cattle fairs at our Paysandú saleyard and at other yards in the region: a quick way to buy and sell calves, heifers and cows that have been inspected beforehand.
points: Monthly fairs at the Paysandú saleyard
Health inspection and weighing on site
Lots grouped by category and weight
Collection and payment handled by the firm

steps.title: Entry

steps.title: Reception
steps.text: The cattle arrive at the yard and are inspected, weighed and grouped.

steps.title: Fair
steps.text: They sell in the pen and we settle within the agreed term.
